text: {"us_status":"written","label_product":"PROGLYCEM (diazoxide) oral suspension, 50 mg/mL — Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc.","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed current version 17; updated 2026-10-06; Rev. 10/2026","label_section":"WARNINGS — Necrotizing Enterocolitis in Neonates and Infants","quote":"There have been postmarketing reports of necrotizing enterocolitis in neonates and infants treated with diazoxide, including fatal cases in neonates.","eu":"EMA PRAC adopted 2025-09-04/published 2025-09-29: update diazoxide SmPC 4.4 and 4.8 for 'Necrotising enterocolitis neonatal'.","uk":"UK Eudemine diazoxide SmPC includes 'Necrotising enterocolitis neonatal' in 4.4 Special warnings and precautions and 4.8 Undesirable effects; text revision 2025-11-21.","us_regulator":"FDA: Drugs@FDA lists SUPPL-25 Labeling-Package Insert approved 2026-10-06; no separate diazoxide-NEC AEMS/FAERS potential-signal or Sentinel evaluation found.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=b16c7832-2fd9-49af-b923-1dc0d91fd6e2","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2026/017453s025lbl.pdf","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cder/daf/index.cfm?ApplNo=017453&event=overview.process","https://www.ema.europa.eu/system/files/documents/prac-recommendation/prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-1-4-september-2025-prac_en.pdf","https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-product-information-about-medicines","https://products.mhra.gov.uk/","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/9136/smpc","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/april-june-2026-new-safety-information-or-potential-signals-serious-risks-identified-fda-adverse","https://www.sentinelinitiative.org/studies/drugs/individual-drug-analyses"]}
